purpose: At most one bounded independent/documentation-only PIT source feasibility decision, not a same-source capture rescue. Do we have externally auditable, comprehensive *as-of* Binance USD-M perpetual identity history BEFORE frozen 2026-10-01 cutoff, independent of present survivors and archive key inference? If no, recommend STOP for current multiyear X1 atlas and at most one fresh prospective-only concept requiring separate new Strategy approval.
scope: Review only existing canonical evidence plus official PUBLIC documentation for at most TWO materially independent source-lineage options. Historical Binance Support category capture and current exchangeInfo already attempted; DO NOT re-issue any HTTP market/announcement/API GET or recreate one-shot job.

Accept a source as plausible only when auditable historical symbol onboarding, delisting effective status, redenomination/multiplier changes, relisting and historical completeness attestations can all be established prior to cutoff. Clearly separate immutability, auditability, actual historic completeness and legal/licensing cost.
Treat vendor-paid/licensed or credentialed raw feeds only as theoretical alternatives and exact USER_COST_T3_GATE, not automatic approval or acquisition.
Evaluate whether X1's broad 1m atlas has a feasible path without using outcome-based survivor selection. The current frozen universe/listing/historical cutoff CANNOT be relaxed on existing evidence.

If no independent PIT source meets requirements in documentation, choose a STOP/DEFER instead of generating busywork; suggest at most one NEW prospectively fixed anchor/target design to investigate later only after a separate mechanism/economic review, NOT a rerun of X1-003.
Three lenses: trader edge-to-fill and opportunity-scale doubt (correlation != alpha); engineering immutable timing/identity/metadata contracts; statistics survivorship and multiplicity/independence.

decision_criteria.earliest_stop: No independent documented historical point-in-time completeness at frozen cutoff => DO NOT request network/coding/data acquisition.

allowed_pr_writes: one exact task report and one manifest LAST on task branch
forbidden_actions: Repeat or modify previous X1 official Binance announcement HTTP capture, exchangeInfo, stream or Test Executor job
Paid/licensed source sign-up, downloads or credentials
Change frozen historical cutoff, symbol set, source eligibility, namespace, selection/confirmation budgets, robustness metrics
Call source absence an alpha rejection; fabricate historical completeness
Implement new strategy, X1-003 discovery, alternate lag/horizon grid or new market data collector
Update shared roadmap, governance, contamination, reusable blocks, Strategy State
Dispatch another task, change PR lifecycle or rerun source
stop_rule: One exact static documentation feasibility pass; report+manifest last, one terminal, Strategy Manager reviews. No new source testing or restart X1 historical atlas without independent source-proof and separate approval.
